notes.title: New Mode Update: Survival
notes.content:
Mastered story mode? Or just looking for a different challenge? The new Survival mode comes with 10 unique levels, followed by an infinite level that ramps in difficulty after each wave.

Share your thoughts on the new mode in our Steam Community forum!
